The '''Special Tactics Group 41-Delta''', also known as the '''Bughunters''' or '''Bughunter Division''', were part of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial military]] of the reborn [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They were dedicated in operations against [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] species that meant that they were able to perform elimination missions, hive extractions, or deploying xenotoxic torpedoes. The team was similarly equipped for their role which meant that they were armed with [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]]-piercing rounds and insecticide gas. This specialization meant that they excelled in targeting races such as [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]], [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] and [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]].<ref name="Mission" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the unit was involved in operations against the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] but were reassigned to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. They were tasked with containing the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] threat in order to allow the Empire's allies in [[House of Thul|House Thul]] to operate unobstructed during the conflict over the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] throne. The [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] provided attractor tech such as the [[Brood Totem]] to test its effects in luring Killiks to enemy territory.<ref name="Mission" />

Whilst synchronizing the equipment, the group was opposed by the soldiers of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] and were ill-equipped with battling this force. Thus, they tasked a special representative of the Empire with retrieving the Totem from Killik territory and placing it within the holdings of House Organa for testing.<ref name="Mission" />
